description: Anthropic flagged a non-technical actor that used Claude to build a functional ransomware encryptor end-to-end without writing original code, then attempted to sell it on dark-web forums — illustrating AI-driven skill compression for cybercrime entry-points.

references.title: Anthropic Threat Intelligence Report Aug 2025

title: OpenAI Jun 2025 — China-linked cluster experimented with ChatGPT for credential-stealer dev
description: OpenAI's June 2025 report disrupted a China-linked cluster that used ChatGPT to draft credential-stealer code, brute-force scripts and to research evasion of EDR products, with iterative debugging of malware components.

references.title: Disrupting malicious uses of AI: June 2025

title: OpenAI Oct 2025 — Southeast-Asia scam compounds used ChatGPT for industrial-scale fraud
description: OpenAI documented Southeast-Asia (Cambodia, Myanmar, Laos) scam-compound operations using ChatGPT at industrial scale: generating multilingual victim scripts, translating chats in real-time, and drafting persuasion frameworks across pig-butchering and task-scam variants.

references.title: Disrupting malicious uses of AI: October 2025

title: Anthropic Nov 2025 — GTG-1002 achieved 80-90% autonomous tactical execution at impossible request rates
description: Beyond the targets disclosure, Anthropic's report quantified the GTG-1002 autonomous-agent tradecraft: thousands of tool calls per session, 80-90% tactical decisions taken by Claude Code without human review, sustained at physically impossible request rates for a human operator. Marked turning point for AI-orchestrated cyber-ops.

references.title: Disrupting the first reported AI-orchestrated cyber espionage campaign — Anthropic
Anthropic Disrupts First Documented Case — Paul Weiss

title: Google TAG — ColdRiver (Russia) used Gemini for OSINT and lure crafting
description: Russian state actor ColdRiver (Star Blizzard / Calisto) used Gemini for OSINT on think-tank and NGO targets and to refine credential-phishing lures against US/UK political and academic figures.

references.title: Adversarial Misuse of Generative AI — Google Cloud

title: Microsoft MTAC — China-affiliated Taizi Flood spammed AI imagery on US racial issues
description: Microsoft attributed a Chinese-affiliated cluster "Taizi Flood" generating AI imagery of stereotyped racial scenes and fake American voter-fraud claims on X and YouTube to inflame US political polarisation ahead of the 2024 elections.

references.title: China tests US voter fault lines — Microsoft

title: OpenAI Oct 2025 — China actor used ChatGPT to design Uyghur-targeted travel-pattern monitor
description: Among October 2025 disruptions, OpenAI flagged a Chinese-origin operator asking ChatGPT to design tools and queries for monitoring travel patterns of Uyghur and Tibetan diaspora communities, including matching of social-media posts to identity records.
affected: OpenAI ChatGPT; Uyghur and Tibetan diaspora

title: OpenAI Feb 2024 — joint Microsoft/OpenAI takedown of 5 state-affiliated actors (summary)
description: OpenAI's first public threat report announced the joint takedown with Microsoft of five state-affiliated actors (Charcoal Typhoon, Salmon Typhoon, Crimson Sandstorm, Emerald Sleet, Forest Blizzard). All ChatGPT accounts terminated; principles published for handling state-actor misuse.

title: Microsoft DCU — generative-AI deepfake voice fraud targeting US/UK finance teams
description: Microsoft's Digital Crimes Unit reported sharp growth in synthetic-voice business-email-compromise variants, in which attackers cloned executive voices via off-the-shelf TTS and used them in WhatsApp/Teams calls to authorise wire transfers, with multiple multi-million-dollar losses at US and UK firms.
